items.title: Joe Burrow can become the first QB ever with 4+ touchdowns in 6 consecutive games
items.text: Burrow and Peyton Manning are the only QBs ever with 4 TDs in 5 straight games. If Burrow does it again on Monday night, he'll be the first in NFL history to do it in 6 straight games.
